chapterInfo.content:
3
Ahonu asɛnka wɔ Ninewe
1Na AWURADE asɛm baa Yona nkyɛn ne mprenu so sɛ: 2#Yona 1.2 Sɔre kɔ Ninewe kuro kɛseɛ no mu, na kɔpae asɛm a mereka makyerɛ woɔ no kyerɛ wɔn. 3#Yona 4.11 Ɛnna Yona sɔre nam AWURADE asɛm no soɔ sii mu kɔɔ Ninewe. Nso na Ninewe yɛ kuro kɛseɛ a nnansa na wɔde twa ho hyia. 4Na Yona firii aseɛ hyɛnee kuro no mu nantee da koro, na ɔpaee sɛ: Aka adaduanan na Ninewe abutu. 5#Mat 12.41 Ɛnna Ninewefoɔ no gyee Onyankopɔn diiɛ, na wɔpaee mmuadadie, na wɔfirafiraa ayitoma firi wɔn mu nnipa akɛseɛ so kɔsii wɔn mu akumaa so.
6Na asɛm no duruu Ninewe hene nkyɛn no, ɔsɔre firii n’adwa so, na ɔyii ne ngusoɔ guu hɔ na ɔfiraa ayitoma, na ɔtenaa nso mu, 7na ɔmaa wɔpaee mu kaa no Ninewe, ɔhene ne n’atitire asɛm so, kaa sɛ: Nnipa ne afieboa, anantwie ne nnwan mmfa hwee nnka wɔn ano, wɔmmma wɔnnkɔdidi, na wɔnnnom nsuo nso. 8Na nnipa ne afieboa mfirafira ayitoma, na wɔnsu dendeenden mfrɛ Onyankopɔn, na wɔnsane mfiri wɔn kwammɔne so ne amim adeɛ a ɛwowɔ wɔn nsam no ho. 9#Yoel 2.14 Obi nnim sɛ ebia Onyankopɔn bɛsesa n’adwene wɔ adeɛ wɔrebɛyɛ no ho, na wadane afiri n’abufuhyeɛ no ho, na wansɛe yɛn.
10 # Yer 18.7-8 Na Onyankopɔn hunuu wɔn nneyɛɛ, sɛ wɔasane afiri wɔn akwammɔne no soɔ, na ɔsesaa n’adwene wɔ bɔne a ɔkaa sɛ ɔde bɛyɛ wɔn no ho, na wanyɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE asɛm baa Yona nkyɛn ne mprenu so sɛ: Sɔre kɔ Ninewe kuro kɛseɛ no mu, na kɔpae asɛm a mereka makyerɛ woɔ no kyerɛ wɔn. Ɛnna Yona sɔre nam AWURADE asɛm no soɔ sii mu kɔɔ Ninewe. Nso na Ninewe yɛ kuro kɛseɛ a nnansa na wɔde twa ho hyia. Na Yona firii aseɛ hyɛnee kuro no mu nantee da koro, na ɔpaee sɛ: Aka adaduanan na Ninewe abutu. Ɛnna Ninewefoɔ no gyee Onyankopɔn diiɛ, na wɔpaee mmuadadie, na wɔfirafiraa ayitoma firi wɔn mu nnipa akɛseɛ so kɔsii wɔn mu akumaa so.
Na asɛm no duruu Ninewe hene nkyɛn no, ɔsɔre firii n’adwa so, na ɔyii ne ngusoɔ guu hɔ na ɔfiraa ayitoma, na ɔtenaa nso mu, na ɔmaa wɔpaee mu kaa no Ninewe, ɔhene ne n’atitire asɛm so, kaa sɛ: Nnipa ne afieboa, anantwie ne nnwan mmfa hwee nnka wɔn ano, wɔmmma wɔnnkɔdidi, na wɔnnnom nsuo nso. Na nnipa ne afieboa mfirafira ayitoma, na wɔnsu dendeenden mfrɛ Onyankopɔn, na wɔnsane mfiri wɔn kwammɔne so ne amim adeɛ a ɛwowɔ wɔn nsam no ho. Obi nnim sɛ ebia Onyankopɔn bɛsesa n’adwene wɔ adeɛ wɔrebɛyɛ no ho, na wadane afiri n’abufuhyeɛ no ho, na wansɛe yɛn.
Na Onyankopɔn hunuu wɔn nneyɛɛ, sɛ wɔasane afiri wɔn akwammɔne no soɔ, na ɔsesaa n’adwene wɔ bɔne a ɔkaa sɛ ɔde bɛyɛ wɔn no ho, na wanyɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
